description: Maps one parameter of another module onto four separate knobs, so several controllers can drive that parameter at once.

params.text: Binds a parameter to this group of four knobs: press it, then click a knob, fader or switch on any module.
Sets the bound parameter, and follows that parameter when it is changed elsewhere unless Read is switched off for this knob.

notes: the four knobs do nothing until the mapping button is pressed and a knob, fader or switch on another module is clicked.
menu: Read — on a knob's own right-click menu, or by double-clicking that knob; switched off, the knob sends its value out and ignores changes made to the parameter elsewhere.
Audio rate processing — switched off, the mapped parameter is updated every 32nd sample instead of every sample.
